name: imflatfield
comment: Sig: imflatfield(I, sigma [, mask]). Smooth synthetic shading on a 32x32 double image. Octave-image 11.1.0 does not have imflatfield so cross-check reports correctness=N/A. Algorithm: F = imgaussfilt(im2double(I), sigma); B = im2cls((I_double./F) * mean(F)). 3-D inputs are processed per-page.
